voice_performance.pause_policy: Beat after 'number' and before 'That is learning.'

sections.label: Hook
sections.text: A neural network does not memorize answers. It guesses, measures how wrong it is, and nudges millions of tiny knobs.

delivery_cues.provider_text: A neural network does not memorize answers. It guesses, measures how wrong it is, and nudges millions of tiny knobs.

sections.label: Weights
sections.text: Those knobs are weights. Each connection multiplies a signal. Stack enough of them and you get a guess.

delivery_cues.provider_text: Those knobs are weights. Each connection multiplies a signal. Stack enough of them and you get a guess.

sections.label: Forward
sections.text: First the signal runs forward. Pixels in, scores out. That is the forward pass.

delivery_cues.provider_text: First the signal runs forward. Pixels in, scores out. That is the forward pass.

sections.label: Loss
sections.text: Then a loss function scores the miss. If the label is cat and the network said dog, the error is a number — not a lecture.

delivery_cues.provider_text: Then a loss function scores the miss. If the label is cat and the network said dog, the error is a number — not a lecture.

sections.label: Backprop
sections.text: Backpropagation sends that error backward. Every weight gets a tiny update: a little more this way, a little less that way.

delivery_cues.provider_text: Backpropagation sends that error backward. Every weight gets a tiny update: a little more this way, a little less that way.

sections.label: Landing
sections.text: Do that millions of times, and the guesses get less wrong. That is learning.

delivery_cues.provider_text: Do that millions of times, and the guesses get less wrong. That is learning.
